human_instruction: 找更多的多链蛋白来测试，不要放单链蛋白

primary_groups.protein: Actual simulated inputs with at least two polypeptide chains representing one mature biological protein identity; includes verified homomultimers or split-chain mature proteins.
primary_groups.protein_complex: Actual simulated inputs containing different biological proteins/independent heterologous peptide partners, using the previously frozen identity policy.

single_chain_primary_exclusion: No one-chain record may appear in the new primary protein group; original complete benchmark and all predictions remain preserved as historical/full-cohort evidence.
expansion_goal: Find and evaluate as many suitable real multichain protein systems as practical locally; current ten records alone are insufficient as the intended expansion.

model_selection.FlexPPI: Full only; do not show Intra in the new comparison.
model_selection.BackFlip_selection_reason: Two main released versions under the same independent-chain inference context; selection does not depend on the new test performance.

source_eligibility: Real molecular-dynamics trajectories or traceable precomputed MD reference with residue identities and units; an AI-generated ensemble is not a substitute for MD ground truth.
Actual simulation topology/trajectory must retain two or more protein chains; PDB entry-level oligomer status alone is insufficient.
Do not duplicate, translate, or concatenate independent single-chain trajectories to manufacture multichain examples.
Classify biological protein identities from actual chain sequences and authoritative annotations; do not relabel heteromer complexes as proteins.
Keep source collection, accession, sequence identity, replicas, duration/temperature/forcefield and input/reference hashes. Replicas are not counted as independent proteins.
Use declared structural support and the original 1024-residue deployment envelope unless a separately documented generalization experiment is prepared. Do not truncate favorable positions.
Do not count restricted/unavailable trajectory listings as acquired usable test data.
evaluation_policy: Freeze inclusion, molecular identity and model protocol before reading new performance.
Identify exact-record/source/sequence-family overlap with actual Full checkpoint training; use genuinely held-out predictions or explicitly separate historical OOF from new external tests.
Do not evaluate a newly named test input with a checkpoint that trained on the same underlying record; a renamed accession is not independence.
Recompute chain-wise rigid-body-removed C-alpha RMSF on real trajectories with explicit replica/time-window policy, or verify compatible source-provided references.
All compared methods use the same static molecular input, matched author residues and frozen valid reference positions. Physical MAE only for absolute-amplitude methods.
No test-dependent calibration, model selection, sample removal or selection of a checkpoint by new test scores.
current_state: Local and public source inventories in progress; no expansion sample count, predictions, scores or new figure claimed complete.
